Hi, I'm David Martin Venti, independent researcher based in Lausanne, Switzerland. I just opened my first Mathlib PR:

feat(SimpleGraph): card of common neighbors equals card of triangles containing edge

https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/pull/37109

The PR adds card_commonNeighbors_eq_card_triangles_containing_edge to Clique.lean, connecting commonNeighbors with cliqueFinset 3.

AI disclosure is included in the PR description.

Happy to receive feedback.
